title: Questions
content: I believe I’ve seen mall world in my dreams, reoccurring since early this year and all lucid. My depictions are a little more modern architecturally speaking but the similarities are very scary, I’ve seen the beach and the cliffs, the large mall though I’ve never been inside only to a part of it that doubles as an event venue in which i normally attend a party or dance. The university has been most intriguing though, I see reoccurring locations & the greatest one is this university style building. Like a building from ucla or any university with very old architecture. It has huge giant pillars around it and large windows, and very large doors. It’s very normal for ancient Roman architecture. Inside there is a lobby and two long hall walls. Sometimes it’s a hotel sometimes it’s a school, and sometimes it’s abandoned. But always the same house the same layout, rooms and all. On the right hallway the first door you see there is a small room that looks similar to a closet it has a small bunk bed inside , on the roof of that room you can pull down a cord which pulls down a wooden staircase or ladder to go up on the next floor without the use of the main elevator or staircases. Everything is dimly lit always. Outside of that I always use a horribly terrifying freeway in which I’m always the one driving. The freeway is similar to a rollercoaster. Then there is a large convention center/hotel at the end of the freeways. There’s a high school on the shore, similar to the one I attended so that detail might be based on experience. And the mall, hotel, convention center and amusement park are all on the shore. The amusement park is normally indoors for me or in the style of universal studios rides where it’s mostly indoors to create a scene. There’s is one insane ride that for some reason I’m always forced to go on, it has an insane drop straight down basically and then curves around itself for the rest of the time. Let me know if that sounds like mall world or if I’m dreaming of somewhere else entirely.
